tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Altai C1n Super WiFi CPE/AP – High-Performance 802.11n Outdoor Access Point

Boost Your WiFi Coverage with the Altai C1n – Long-Range, High-Speed, and Weatherproof

The Altai C1n Super WiFi CPE/AP is a high-performance, long-range 802.11n access point designed for outdoor and indoor deployments. Engineered with patented smart-signal processing technology, this device enhances WiFi signal strength, client throughput, and overall network stability. Whether used as a CPE for extending coverage or a standalone access point, the Altai C1n provides up to 250m line-of-sight (LOS) coverage with dual slant ±45° antennas for optimized signal reception.

Key Features:

  • Superior Signal Strength – Patented smart-signal processing enhances performance in LOS & NLOS conditions
  • Long-Range Coverage – Provides up to 250m WiFi coverage with a 10 dBi dual-slant sector antenna
  • Multi-Mode Functionality – Operates as a CPE, standalone AP, or repeater
  • Bandwidth Control & User Isolation – Supports per-client/VAP bandwidth control and secure multi-user isolation
  • Remote Management – Web-based management with real-time client status monitoring
  • Weatherproof & Durable – IP55-rated enclosure for outdoor deployments in extreme conditions
  • Easy & Quick Installation – 8-level LED alignment for precise signal positioning

Technical Specifications:

  • Wireless Standard: 802.11b/g/n (2×2 MIMO) | Frequency: 2.4 GHz (2.400 – 2.485 GHz, Ch 1-13)
  • Max Transmit Power: 29 dBm (Max), 26 dBm per chain
  • Antenna Gain: 10 dBi Dual Slant ±45° Sector
  • Coverage: Up to 250m (LOS)
  • Network Interface: 10/100 Mbps Ethernet Port
  • Security: WPA/WPA2/WPA3, MAC-based access control, Dynamic VLAN Assignment, Firewall
  • Management: AltaiGate, AltaiCare, SSH, SNMP v1/v2c/v3, Web UI
  • Power Supply: 18V Passive PoE or 802.3af PoE (Adapter Required)
  • Power Consumption: 6W (Typical) / 8W (Max)
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to +55°C
  • Certifications: FCC, CE, RoHS Compliant

What’s in the Box?

  • 1x Altai C1n Super WiFi CPE/AP
  • 1x Mounting Kit (Pole, Wall, or Window-Mounted)
  • 1x Quick Installation Guide

Why Choose Altai C1n?

  •  Ideal for Large-Area Coverage – Perfect for rural areas, warehouses, hotels, and outdoor environments
  •  Robust & Reliable – Handles wind speeds up to 200 km/h and extreme temperatures
  • Optimized for Wireless ISPs – Supports PPPoE, NAT, VLAN, DHCP, and Multicast Filtering
  • Seamless Network Expansion – Works with Altai Super WiFi Base Stations for large-scale connectivity
